title: Ashbury Rewards Tier Benefits Chart: Welcome Amenity Points
content:
Welcome amenity points are an elite recognition of Ashbury Rewards, and the chart below sets the amount per stay for each tier and for each of the two brand groups. The full-service brands are Ashbury Hotel, Ashbury Grand, Ashbury Resort & Spa and Ashbury Reserve; the select-service brands are Ashbury Express and Ashbury Inn & Suites.

## Welcome amenity chart

| Tier | Welcome points per stay at Ashbury Hotel, Ashbury Grand, Ashbury Resort & Spa and Ashbury Reserve | Welcome points per stay at Ashbury Express and Ashbury Inn & Suites | Also given on Reward Night Rate stays | Welcome points posted once per stay |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Member | 0 | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite | 0 | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 500 | 250 | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | 1000 | 500 | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite | 1000 | 500 | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 1000 | 500 | Yes | Yes |

## Notes to the chart

- At Ashbury Rewards Member and Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite the welcome amount is 0 at both brand groups.
- The select-service amount is half of the full-service amount at every tier that has one: 250 against 500 at Gold Elite, 500 against 1000 at Platinum, Titanium and Ambassador Elite.
- Platinum, Titanium and Ambassador Elite share the same amounts.
- Reward Night Rate stays are not excluded at any tier.

## Reading the chart (hypothetical stays)

| Tier | Hotel | Welcome amount read from the chart |
|---|---|---|
| Gold Elite | Ashbury Inn & Suites | 250 |
| Gold Elite | Ashbury Resort & Spa | 500 |
| Titanium Elite | Ashbury Express | 500 |
| Silver Elite | Ashbury Reserve | 0 |
